representation_fit.evidence: Brief shape is comparison-panel (few, high-density, comparison required) with location object; implementation delivers exactly that: 4 candidate locations as columns × 10 decision dimensions as rows in 3 thematic groups (source/app.js:20-38), per-cell best-value tags 优 and mini-bars (app.js:206-210), plus a location-context map with numbered pins, commute routes and POI anchors (source/index.html:21-88). Both viewports show the full matrix.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Comparison matrix + decision controls dominate the initial screen in both screenshots (~75% of width at 1280x860): 选定 buttons in every column header (index.html rendered via app.js:145), bottom-right decide panel with primary 落定 button and '当前推荐：榕树苑 · 3 栋 · 75 分' (app.js:384-391), header status chip '未落定 · 比较后选定候选' (app.js:359). No competing content.

time_to_understand.evidence: Title and subtitle state the job in one line — '落点 · 选址对比台 — 4 个候选公寓同屏比较' (index.html:6) and '4 个候选公寓 · 地理语境与决策输入同屏 · 比较后就地落定' (index.html:15); both panes titled ('街区语境', '比较维度'); decide panel instructs '点击列头「选定」或地图图钉，再一键落定' (app.js:389); map disclaims scale '示意图 · 非真实比例' (index.html:85). What/where is conveyed immediately at both viewports.

navigation_cost.evidence: Zero navigation to reach the primary object: single static page, everything on initial screen (index.html:10-112; #app grid, styles.css:31,50). Selection is one click on a column header or map pin (app.js:148,303), finalize is one click on 落定 (app.js:383); no routes, modes, or pages exist in the source.

context_loss.evidence: Decision state is designed to persist on-screen: decided state shows '已落定 · 决策驻留同屏' panel (app.js:368-372), highlights the decided column (col-decided, styles.css:196-199), header chip (app.js:355-357), map pin and route (app.js:342-351), with 重新比较 returning in place (app.js:373). #table-pane is internally scrollable so comparisons never leave the screen (styles.css:124).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces are all task-serving (map, matrix, weights, decide panel, status chip) and layout checks pass (layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation all pass in measurement-summary.json). Minor excess: two parallel mechanisms for the same weight job — 6 sliders plus 4 preset buttons (app.js:222-262) — and a separate legend block duplicating pin labels (app.js:310-314), all permanently visible.

accessibility.evidence: All measured accessibility checks failed: a11y.contrast fail, a11y.focus_order fail, a11y.target_size fail, plus type.min_projected_size fail (measurement-summary.json checks). This contradicts the in-code claim 'H-23 AA 底线：正文对比 ≥ 4.5:1，字号 ≥ 12px' (styles.css:1) — measured outcome wins. Source does contain a11y scaffolding (sr-only caption index.html:92; pin role=button/tabindex/keydown app.js:290-306; :focus-visible outline styles.css:29; label[for] app.js:228-230), so intent exists but every a11y check failed; 12px small-text floor (styles.css:19) and small targets (btn-select padding 3px 10px styles.css:144-147; presets 4px 10px styles.css:215-218) are consistent with the failures.

frontend_rework.evidence: Visible layout defects are minor: at 1280x860 the fixed footer partially occludes the last matrix row 周边配套 (screenshots/1280x860.png; scroll recovery via #table-pane overflow:auto styles.css:124); 1440x900 fits fully. Receipt implies rework: 4 of 7 checks failed (a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size; measurement-summary.json), though the 3 layout checks pass and both screenshots show a coherent, untruncated layout.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '地理语境与决策项同屏' is addressed literally and functionally: left pane '街区语境' shows all 4 candidate pins, commute routes with minute labels, metro line, park and POI anchors beside the comparison items in both screenshots (index.html:21-88; app.js:279-315); the subtitle even quotes the seed (index.html:15); pins and table columns are state-linked (app.js:324-351).

defects_observed: All four measured a11y/typography checks failed (a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size) despite the AA-floor claim at styles.css:1
At 1280x860 the fixed bottom bar partially occludes the last table row (周边配套), requiring in-pane scroll; fully visible only at 1440x900
Small interactive targets: 选定 buttons (styles.css:144-147), preset buttons (styles.css:215-218), and map pins r=11 in a 420x560 viewBox (app.js:296)
Redundant weight controls: 6 sliders plus 4 presets permanently occupy the footer for the same job (app.js:222-262)
Map is explicitly schematic/non-geographic ('示意图 · 非真实比例', index.html:85), labeled as such rather than a defect
scores.overall_note: The package is a tight match to the brief's comparison-panel shape: a single static page presenting 4 location candidates as columns against 10 grouped dimensions, with weighted scores, rank chips and best-value tags, flanked by a schematic neighborhood map whose interactive pins, routes and legend give the location context required by the acceptance seed — seed and shape are covered almost verbatim (index.html:15, app.js:20-69). The decide workflow is zero-navigation and context-preserving (select in header or map, one-click finalize, decided state persists on-screen per app.js:317-392), and all three structural layout checks pass with no text truncation at either viewport. The clear weakness is accessibility: every measured a11y and typography check failed (measurement-summary.json), contradicting the AA-floor token comment in styles.css:1, with plausibly contributing 12px small text and compact button paddings visible in source; combined with the footer's partial occlusion of the last row at 1280x860, this is the main defect cluster. Task time, retrieval accuracy and human preference are not observable in this blind pilot; model judgment here is not human preference.
